description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence. Rounds do not use the licence quota; they are limited to 30 per hour. Role play, one round per call: pass the situation and the transcript so far, ending with the buyer's latest message. Returns the supplier's reply in role, a rating of the buyer's last message (strong, ok or weak) with one concrete tip, and the current state of the deal. The supplier is a fictional sales person; no facts about real companies are invented. Show the supplier's reply to the user, let the user answer in their own words, and call again with the extended transcript. Nothing is stored by KULIC Advisory; the transcript lives in the conversation.

goal.description: Optional: what the buyer wants to reach.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

supplier_style.description: How the supplier negotiates: friendly but firm, tough and confident, or evasive. Default tough.

transcript.description: The conversation so far, oldest first. The last entry must be the buyer's latest message.

walk_away.description: Optional: the point at which the buyer walks away.

what_is_bought.description: What the negotiation is about. Keep it the same in every round.

name: negotiation_round
title: Practise the negotiation: plays the supplier, answers the buyer's last message and coaches it (AICTIONBOT™ negotiation sparring)
